<p align="center"><strong>Discovery - Elias is a prisoner, and his welcome is part of the trap.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">&quot;Ada was my daughter. The thing outside sounded so frightened that I answered, though I had just put her to bed. That was the thirteenth knock.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">&quot;Now she makes me welcome the next guest. If I offer tea, watch my hands. I can still point to an exit. I cannot make my mouth tell you why.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">&quot;The beacon releases every stolen name when it faces the northern path. Afterward, leave with them, or keep the light through the next October. Never answer the thirteenth knock.&quot;</p>
